claims.claim: The scraped prosecraft dataset covers 22,449 books, each with total words, vividness, passive voice, all adverbs, ly-adverbs and non-ly-adverbs.
The dataset's author states that the book list was obtained from prosecraft.io by scraping its word-count percentile pages.
claims.quote: My first goal was to obtain a list of books from prosecraft.io
